diameterInterpretation: ADAM nonconvex reconstruction constrained by VLT/SPHERE images. Selected archive volume-equivalent diameter: 141 ±2 km. The grid marks unavailable imagery; rotational phase is illustrative.

calibration.uncertaintyKind: Archive estimate of volume-equivalent diameter error; not a bound on local shape accuracy.
calibration.diameterSemantics: Volume-equivalent diameter in the selected DAMIT record; actual source publications and release differences are documented in selectionNotes.
calibration.limitations: The pinned mesh is an inverse model, not a directly sampled surface. No registered reflectance mosaic is supplied by this release; a neutral grid must mark unavailable imagery. Fine-scale craters, regolith and albedo are unresolved. Absolute rotational phase is illustrative. Select Vernazza et al. (2021) ADAM model 5914 over older convex 1086. The VLT/SPHERE imaging study reports volume-equivalent 141 ±2 km, agreeing with the selected archive diameter and raw volume 141.094. MPCD is a promising refinement documented in the paper; its linked LAM release could not be retrieved during this survey. The mounted source is the pinned ADAM mesh, not an unverified MPCD or reflectance product.
